objective: Implement CFR-168 as one decision-equivalent resource contract: deterministic Trace work counters, iterative bounded ancestry/signature/object traversal, command-scoped validated memoization, and pre-publication HTTP response budgets without changing semantic results or corruption diagnostics.

risk.rationale: The root crosses Core, Store, CLI, signatures, object transfer, HTTP, metrics, and Python compatibility while preserving sealed and remote safety semantics.

evidence_refs: CFR-168 characterization: changed_atoms times links scan, recursive signature history, full ancestor map, full object/HTTP materialization
CFR-167 Retrospect completed; CFR-168 is the next frozen root

disallowed_actions: Return a successful partial graph or HTTP bundle
Change Trace propagation from direct-only to transitive
Trust a persistent path, mtime, or size-only cache
Add a runtime dependency without an accepted ADR

non_goals: Build a persistent graph database or distributed service
Change devcontainer, CI, packaging, or the dogfood project's implementation

invariants.statement: Indexed, memoized, and iterative evaluators preserve the exact existing result, order, identity, and corruption diagnostics.
invariants.falsification_test: Run reference and optimized evaluators on linear, cycle, diamond, duplicate-edge, wide-DAG, missing, and corrupt fixtures and compare normalized outputs byte-for-byte.

invariants.statement: Every charged allocation, queue insertion, object parse, response encoding, or mutation effect occurs only while the applicable budget remains available.
invariants.falsification_test: Exercise every dimension at limit minus one, exact limit, and limit plus one and assert typed failure before response headers or authority writes.

invariants.statement: Repository corruption and resource-budget exhaustion remain distinct typed outcomes.
invariants.falsification_test: Place the same corrupt record before and after a budget boundary and assert corruption wins when encountered inside the admitted work subject.

invariants.statement: Metrics collection is privacy-safe aggregate evidence and never controls semantic evaluation.
invariants.falsification_test: Compare metrics-disabled and metrics-enabled command results after removing only the metrics member.

invariants.statement: Supported commit/signature/object traversals do not depend on process call-stack depth and visit each subject at most once per command session.
invariants.falsification_test: Validate a deep linear history and shared DAG while asserting iterative completion, bounded queue depth, and deterministic node/read counters.

validation.purpose: Prove Trace/reference equivalence and counter slopes.
Prove ancestry, signature, object, HTTP, metrics, and typed exhaustion behavior.
Preserve Python fallback and cross-runtime behavior.
Keep issue, architecture, command, and data-model sources synchronized.

validation.command: Run a fresh isolated install, installed scale/budget reversals, Algorithm 281 tests, and installed status/scan/verify/doctor before Close.
validation.purpose: Prove the source fix in the runtime and canonical dogfood lifecycle.
